title: PDE-Based Bounds on Optimal Exponents in Active Simple Hypothesis Testing
abstract: arXiv:2610.36657v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present general upper and lower bounds on the optimal error exponent for the Active Simple Hypothesis Testing (ASHT) problem. ASHT has been extensively studied across diverse fields including Information Theory, Bandits, and Operations Research, a precise characterization of this optimal exponent has remained elusive. This work combines a recent Partial Differential Equation (PDE) characterization of the optimal exponent by Vijayan (2025) with the comparison principle of viscosity solutions of Hamilton-Jacobi PDEs. This leads to bounds that are parametrized by convex functions, sets and lower Hamiltonian relaxations, a flexibility that generalizes many known results in the literature.

translated_title: 基于偏微分方程的主动简单假设检验最优指数的界
translated_abstract: 我们提出了主动简单假设检验（Active Simple Hypothesis Testing, ASHT）问题中最优误差指数的一般上下界。ASHT在信息论、老虎机问题以及运筹学等多个领域都得到了广泛研究，但对这一最优指数的精确刻画始终悬而未决。本工作将Vijayan（2025）近期提出的关于最优指数的偏微分方程（PDE）刻画与Hamilton-Jacobi偏微分方程粘性解的比较原理相结合。由此得到的界以凸函数、集合和下哈密顿松弛作为参数，这种灵活性使得该结果能够推广文献中的许多已知结论。
tldr: 本文通过结合Vijayan（2025）的偏微分方程刻画与Hamilton-Jacobi方程粘性解的比较原理，为主动简单假设检验的最优误差指数建立了由凸函数、集合和下哈密顿松弛参数化的一般上下界，从而推广了文献中的许多已知结果。
en_tdlr: By combining the recent PDE characterization of the optimal exponent with the comparison principle of viscosity solutions of Hamilton-Jacobi PDEs, this paper establishes general upper and lower bounds on the optimal error exponent in Active Simple Hypothesis Testing, parametrized by convex functions, sets, and lower Hamiltonian relaxations, thereby generalizing many known results in the literature.
